description: This PHP source file defines the AdminChannelResourceEditForm class, which handles the creation and processing of an administrative form for editing channel resources within the Goteo platform. The form includes fields for title, description, action URL, download URL, image, channel node selection, and resource category, and contains logic for saving form data, including image handling.

classes.name: AdminChannelResourceEditForm
classes.description: A form processor class for editing channel resources in the admin area, facilitating creation, validation, and saving of form data including handling images and selected categories.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Constructs a form with fields for title, description, action URL, download URL, image, channel node, and category, populating choices from Node and NodeResourceCategory data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the form data into the associated model, handling image uploads/removals, and throwing exceptions on errors.
